description: Current swimming and family scores (0 to 10) with water temperature, wave height and wind for Mallorca beaches, from the hourly forecast and official AEMET warnings. Optionally filter to one beach or one region. Each answer states when it was generated and until when it is valid.

beach.description: Beach slug or name, for example "es-trenc" or "Cala Tuent".

language.description: Language of names and labels: en, de, es or ca. Default en.

region.description: Part of the island. Omit for all.

name: get_conditions
title: Current beach conditions
